name: D-TensoRF
definition: A dynamic radiance field model that maps 3D location x, viewing direction d, and time instant t to emitted color c and volume density σ using factorized 4D/5D tensor grids.
summary: D-TensoRF is a dynamic radiance field model that uses factorized 4D and 5D tensor grids with matrix decomposition to efficiently represent time-varying scenes, reducing memory complexity compared to naive 4D grids.
